Key
Metric

Develop and follow JSAs for all tasks
All tasks are developed and followed JSA.

Assistance is successful.

• Good analytical and supervisory skill.
• Work flexible hours to accommodate job requirements.
• Fluent in English, both
spoken and written is an advantage

Certification

• If candidates do not meet the requirements specified in the Education section, evaluation shall be conducted in accordance with KKNI Level 6.

Other Requirements

1. Develop and drive Operational Technology (OT) strategies and initiatives to support operational reliability, efficiency, and digital transformation objectives.

2. Develop system planning and architecture for OT solutions, including electrical systems, instrumentation, automation, SCADA, industrial networking, and cybersecurity.

3. Establish and maintain standards, procedures, and governance for OT systems and infrastructure.

4. Plan, coordinate, and lead OT projects from design, implementation, and commissioning through to system handover.

5. Analyze operational and technical challenges and determine appropriate technology solutions to improve system performance and reliability.

6. Develop and execute improvement programs focused on automation, system integration, digitalization, and operational optimization.

7. Conduct technical coaching, knowledge transfer, and competency development activities for internal teams and stakeholders.

8. Initiate and lead continuous improvement and innovation projects to enhance OT system effectiveness, efficiency, and security.

Requirements:
1. Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering

2. ⁠Minimum 5 years of experience in Operational Technology (OT), industrial automation, or control system environments.

3. ⁠Strong understanding of industrial automation and control systems.

4. Hands-on experience with PLC programming and industrial automation systems (e.g., Siemens, Mitsubishi).

5. ⁠Strong understanding of industrial machinery, manufacturing processes, and equipment operation.

6. ⁠Fluent in English and Mandarin proficiency will be a strong advantage.

7. Strong leadership, planning, communication, analytical thinking, and conceptual thinking capabilities.

8. ⁠Willingness to travel extensively and be placed across company operations in Indonesia.

1. Mengembangkan dan mengarahkan strategi serta inisiatif Operational Technology (OT) untuk mendukung keandalan operasional, efisiensi, dan tujuan transformasi digital.

2. Menyusun perencanaan dan arsitektur sistem untuk solusi OT, termasuk sistem kelistrikan, instrumentasi, otomasi, SCADA, jaringan industri, dan keamanan siber.

3. Menetapkan serta memelihara standar, prosedur, dan tata kelola untuk sistem dan infrastruktur OT.

4. Merencanakan, mengoordinasikan, dan memimpin proyek OT mulai dari tahap desain, implementasi, commissioning, hingga serah terima sistem.

5. Menganalisis tantangan operasional dan teknis serta menentukan solusi teknologi yang tepat untuk meningkatkan kinerja dan keandalan sistem.

6. Mengembangkan dan melaksanakan program perbaikan yang berfokus pada otomasi, integrasi sistem, digitalisasi, dan optimalisasi operasional.

7. Melaksanakan pembinaan teknis, transfer pengetahuan, dan pengembangan kompetensi bagi tim internal serta pemangku kepentingan terkait.

8. Menginisiasi dan memimpin proyek inovasi serta perbaikan berkelanjutan untuk meningkatkan efektivitas, efisiensi, dan keamanan sistem OT.

Kualifikasi:

1. Pendidikan minimal Sarjana (S1) Teknik Elektro.

2. Memiliki pengalaman minimal 5 tahun di bidang Operational Technology (OT), otomasi industri, atau sistem kontrol industri.

3. Memiliki pemahaman yang kuat mengenai sistem otomasi dan kontrol industri.

4. Memiliki pengalaman praktis dalam pemrograman PLC dan sistem otomasi industri (misalnya Siemens dan Mitsubishi).

5. Memiliki pemahaman yang baik mengenai mesin industri, proses manufaktur, dan pengoperasian peralatan produksi.

6. Mampu berkomunikasi dalam Bahasa Inggris dengan baik; kemampuan berbahasa Mandarin menjadi nilai tambah.

7. Memiliki kemampuan kepemimpinan, perencanaan, komunikasi, berpikir analitis, dan berpikir konseptual yang kuat.

8. Bersedia melakukan perjalanan dinas yang intensif dan ditempatkan di berbagai lokasi operasional perusahaan di seluruh Indonesia.

Founded in 1966, Kalbe Farma (Kalbe) is the largest publicly-listed pharmaceutical company in Southeast Asia. As of end 2023, Kalbe’s extensive healthcare ecosystem encompasses a network of 47 companies, including subsidiaries, joint ventures, and associates, all driven by a dedicated workforce of 16,795 employees.

Guided by a vision to become the country’s best global healthcare company, Kalbe offers a comprehensive healthcare solution through its four key business divisions: prescription pharmaceuticals, consumer health, nutrition, and distribution & logistics. Within these divisions, Kalbe manages a diverse portfolio reinforced by a robust distribution network that serves over one million outlets across Indonesia’s vast archipelago.

On the international stage, Kalbe has established a strong presence in ASEAN countries, as well as regions spanning East and South Asia, the Middle East, and Africa. Kalbe’s business ventures are supported by best in- class research and development capabilities, developed through strategic alliances with many international partners. The Company is deeply involved in cutting-edge areas such as drug delivery systems, cancer treatment, stem cell research, and biotechnology.

Job Description

- Develop and maintain client relationships.
- Execute sales plan of actions as deployed from superior on monthly and quarterly basis (include plan of customer visit, expenses, sales target per outlet/customer, etc).

- Mengembangkan dan mempertahankan hubungan dengan klien.
- Melaksanakan rencana aksi penjualan yang diberikan oleh atasan secara bulanan dan triwulanan (termasuk rencana kunjungan pelanggan, pengeluaran, target penjualan per outlet/pelanggan, dll).

Company:
KF PT. Kalbe Farma Tbk.
